question: The new Pact on Migration and Asylum changes the framework for responsibility-sharing between Member States. It is crucial for Member States along the external border, such as Greece, to have a clear picture regarding potential transfers of applicants for international protection to their territory from other EU Member States. In view of the above, can the Commission answer the following: 1.

How many transfers of applicants for international protection to Greece does it foresee in 2026 and 2027 under the new rules for determining which Member State is responsible for an asylum application?
From which Member States are these transfers expected to take place and on the basis of what criteria will the number of transfers be determined?
How will it ensure that the application of the rules on determining responsibility does not disproportionately increase the pressure on countries of first entry, in particular Greece?
